[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/07/18 (Tue) 09:03  
[EVENT] User received their pre-ordered Apple Watch Series 7 today.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Congratulations on your new Apple Watch Series 7!  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pairing your Apple Watch with your iPhone is a straightforward process.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Before You Begin: Make sure your iPhone is running iOS 15 or later, ensure both your iPhone and Apple Watch are fully charged, and turn on your Apple Watch by pressing and holding the side button until you see the Apple logo.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Pairing Your Apple Watch with Your iPhone: On your iPhone, open the Watch app, tap on Start Pairing, tap on Continue on your Apple Watch, hold your Apple Watch close to your iPhone, tap Continue on your iPhone, enter the six-digit code displayed on your Apple Watch on your iPhone, agree to the terms and conditions, choose whether to restore from a backup or set up as a new watch, follow the in-app instructions to configure additional settings, and your Apple Watch will start syncing with your iPhone.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Final Steps: On your Apple Watch, go to Settings > General > About to ensure your watch is connected to your iPhone, and explore the Watch app on your iPhone to customize your Apple Watch experience.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If you encounter any issues during the pairing process, feel free to ask, and I'll be happy to help.
